requirement: The open repo's tracy builder connects to a Tracy account with the OAuth device flow and builds a demo with one press, without a second demo after a timeout

oracle.ref: PR #1698 (feat); fix evidence: Before: builders/tracy.js was a planned stub that threw BUILDER_PLANNED; the place page only linked to tracy.ai
oracle.invariant: S1: the page sees the user code and link but never a token or device code; slow_down adds 5 s before the next poll; denied and expired end with error access_denied / expired_token; the token file has mode 0600. S2: exactly one refresh for the five calls, the rotated pair written before use; revoked → state reconnect with no token kept; disconnect posts the refresh token to /oauth/revoke and deletes the file. S3: the request body is website-opportunities/demo-request/v1 with the business name and location; a second press answers the same demo; ready → demo url, editUrl, expiresAt on GET /:id, the row in the Outreach stage with a draft carrying the link. S4: one demo only after the timeout (same Idempotency-Key and bytes); 409 with live and limit kept on the demo as refused; 503 surfaced; cancel reaches Tracy.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: connect shows a code and a link
slow_down makes the next poll wait five seconds longer
a denied code ends the flow
an expired code ends the flow
many calls that find the token expired share ONE refresh
a grant revoked in Tracy turns the connection to Reconnect
disconnect revokes the grant in Tracy
Build it with Tracy sends the place, then the tick follows the demo to ready
a timeout never makes a second demo
the live demo limit comes back with its numbers
Build: the live demo limit names both numbers
